scripts.dev:backend: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path backend/.venv) { .\backend\.venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --port 8000 } else { python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --port 8000 }"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path backend/.venv) { .\backend\.venv\Scripts\pytest backend/app/tests } else { python -m pytest backend/app/tests }"
